fusions.name: Spotted Landing
fusions.desc: You leap up to 7 tiles onto the target and bite it for 12 damage, leaving it [Marked] for 8 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Hop
fusions.desc: A leaping strike that deals 7 damage, up to 2 times that at its maximum reach of 8 tiles. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Vantage Hop
fusions.desc: You blink 3 tiles and your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Landing Spot
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your crit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 5 seconds.
